status: receipt-gated vertical design frozen before any Airflows point-level vertical magnitude is inspected or summarized
opening_firewall: receipt file must exist and have status HEIGHT_MAY_OPEN
point-member SHA256 must match the receipt
current point-preflight contract SHA256 must match receipt
only panels listed in receipt.panels may be evaluated

vertical_completeness.rule: within every frozen training night of an admitted panel, every retained row must have finite numeric height_gener
vertical_completeness.failure: panel becomes VERTICAL_DATA_STOP; do not drop rows, sessions or individuals and do not change thresholds

processing.session: timestamp minus 12 hours then calendar date, exactly as frozen preflight
processing.session_centering: subtract median height_gener of the entire frozen retained night

estimator.self_profile: equal-weight other frozen training nights of same individual
estimator.other_profile: pool frozen training nights within each other individual then equal-weight other individuals
estimator.common_cell_weighting: derive equal-night self cell weights on target-supported cells and apply identical weights to self and other vertical profiles
estimator.target_score: mean supported target-event log P_self(centered z) - log P_other(centered z)
estimator.aggregation: equal frozen target night within individual, then equal individual

null.action: permute individual identity labels across the frozen training-night universe within panel while preserving the exact session-count multiset per identity
null.target_sessions: fixed receipt target sessions; recompute self/other profiles, support and common weights under each permutation

panel_pass_rule: observed minus null mean > 0 and one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05
reporting: horizontal calibrated excess and p copied verbatim from preflight receipt
claim_boundary: Each panel is an independent prospective panel only relative to its own unopened vertical magnitude under this programme.
A panel FAIL remains FAIL; do not change grid, bins, sessions, thresholds, target nights or individual membership.
A VERTICAL_DATA_STOP is not a negative vertical result.
Same-taxon Eidolon panels remain distinct studies and are not pooled into one source-level verdict.
No cross-panel predictor model is opened unless the separately frozen comparative-programme stage-2 threshold is reached.
